audit.why: win[] reads Jayce/Jayce/Jayce/Skill/Skill/Master Yi/Master Yi and every why agrees: you own the artillery levels, it evens at 4-6, and his first item takes it. Matches the packet level chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes were named without any of the mechanics that make them spikes, and level 6 was described only as 'Highlander'.
audit.why: Highlander is 85s and makes him immune to slows, so your Shock Blast slow stops being a kiting tool the moment it is up; kills and assists extend the duration and lower his other cooldowns. His real jump in threat is that plus his first item.
audit.corrected: Spike text now names Alpha Strike untargetability, Wuju Style and Highlander's slow immunity.

audit.whatIsWrong: Neither Alpha Strike nor Meditate is mentioned anywhere, and the page never says why the hammer knockback is the peel button.
audit.why: Alpha Strike makes him untargetable for the duration of the dash, so an orb fired into it is wasted and Thundering Blow cannot even select him mid-dash; his basic attacks lower its cooldown from the 20s base. Meditate is a channel, so a knockback ends it outright. Highlander's slow immunity is what leaves displacement as your only peel.
audit.corrected: Fire after Alpha Strike, not into it; Thundering Blow breaks Meditate and is the only peel that beats Highlander.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere in this matchup.
audit.why: Alpha Strike 20s at rank 1 (shortened by his autos), Meditate 10s, Wuju Style 14s and Highlander 85s are the four timers the whole lane runs on.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into early, mid and late.

audit.why: Meditate is a 10s heal-and-damage-reduction channel that also banks Double Strike stacks, so Grievous Wounds is what stops him resetting a losing skirmish.

edits.before: Own the artillery phase completely — Shock Blast through Acceleration Gate keeps Yi off CS at levels 1-2, and the hammer knockback answers the rare all-in at 3. This is a deny-lane: every missed minion delays his items, and his items are the entire matchup. By 4-5 his scaling stirs, so bank the lead and stop taking even trades.
edits.after: Own the artillery phase completely — Shock Blast through Acceleration Gate keeps Yi off CS at levels 1-2, and Thundering Blow answers the rare all-in at 3. Alpha Strike is 20s at rank 1 and he is untargetable through the whole dash, so fire the orb after it lands, never into it. Every missed minion delays his items, and his items are the entire matchup.

edits.before: You get no ult spike at 6 while he gets Highlander, so the window keeps narrowing — and at his first item the gap-close all-in genuinely wins. Convert before that: plates off your shove, roams off gate speed, and picks with your jungler. When he is on the map, poke from maximum range and punt him away the instant he closes the distance.
edits.after: You get no ult spike at 6 while he gets Highlander — 85s, and it makes him immune to slows, so your Shock Blast slow stops kiting him. Convert before his first item: plates off your shove, roams off gate speed, and picks with your jungler. When he is on the map, poke from maximum range and punt him away with the hammer the instant he closes.

edits.before: Two-plus items his true damage crushes a squishy Jayce in any duel, so your late game is played at 1500 range: siege with accelerated Shock Blasts, chunk him before fights start, and hold hammer E purely as the anti-Highlander peel button. Stay glued to your team — a Jayce caught alone is a Yi highlight reel, and both of you know it.
edits.after: Two-plus items his true damage crushes a squishy Jayce in any duel, so your late game is played at 1500 range: siege with accelerated Shock Blasts, chunk him before fights start, and hold hammer E as the anti-Highlander peel — slow immunity leaves displacement as your only answer, and it also ends a Meditate channel. Buy Grievous Wounds, stay with your team.

edits.before: Level 6 stays skill — you get no ult spike, but Highlander alone does not break your spacing yet.
edits.after: Level 6 stays skill — no ult spike for you, and an 85s Highlander alone does not yet break your spacing.

edits.after: Alpha Strike untargetability plus his first item — poke range only.
